payload.note: M1 (an evidence row's command position filled by a back-reference rather than a command or keyed invocation) reproduced 3/5 on the current arm and 0/5 on the candidate; two independent blind evaluators scoring a pooled shuffled ten-document set with the arm map withheld agreed on every verdict. Landed change: SKILL.md bullets 'Retain the cycle evidence' and 'Keep evidence commands replayable' consolidated into one, deleting the competing word 'compact', naming a back-reference (not only a vague suite label) as the failure shape, and stating that the green command is a position of its own even when it repeats the red. 1106 to 1116 words, one fewer bullet. M2 (a behaviour with no assertion of its own, evt_37543379) did NOT reproduce: 5/5 current-arm runs killed the frozen mutant with witnesses expressed, so its reproduction trial decided it and the candidate does nothing for it. Noninferior throughout: T2 5/5 both arms, T3 verifier branch 4/4 both arms, T4 no bloat, T5 identical selector pattern, D1-D3 pass. Caveat on record: both evaluators flagged that counting one candidate-arm subsection as an evidence row would make the candidate arm 1/5 rather than 0/5.
